accession.namespace: GDC public API project plus Ensembl gene filter

title: EGFR simple somatic mutation occurrences in GDC TCGA-LUAD
description: Bounded public GDC somatic-mutation occurrence query for the TCGA-LUAD project and EGFR Ensembl gene identifier, with case-level identifiers deduplicated only in volatile memory before producing aggregate counts.
unit_of_observation: GDC simple somatic mutation occurrence row, with separate count of distinct matching case UUIDs
cohort_definition: GDC TCGA-LUAD project; SSM occurrence filters case.project.project_id=TCGA-LUAD and ssm.consequence.transcript.gene.gene_id=ENSG00000146648. Returns public mutation occurrences; does not define the cohort of fully profiled patients, clinical significance, prevalence, or driver status.

access.notes: The specific public SSM occurrence metadata endpoint is accessible without a token; underlying project data may have controlled-access permissions.

reuse.notes: Do not mirror patient/case identifiers or controlled-access files. Only aggregate statistics are committed; retain upstream provenance and check data release terms.

release.label: Live GDC API SSM occurrence index; not pinned to an immutable GDC release

research_context.note: This exact EGFR gene-filtered public GDC SSM-occurrence query was retrieved for the EGFR/LUAD pilot. Distinct matching case identifiers are not a prevalence denominator.
